title: Diamond Boulevard: Lot 57 renamed, the inside from the owner's photos, three seamless exits, the side patio and the back yard
lensAText: FIRST open every reference in /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-Claude/104ede24-b5bc-5131-bb4c-1bc7e86a4fd2/scratchpad/owner/lot57-inside-2026-11-16/ with the Read tool: the four interior renders govern the inside; the two .jpg photos are a REAL business (use only their generic layout; reject any of its logo, name, wave mural or its colour set). Then: a sceptical environment art director. Look at every side-by-side the builder cites with the Read tool, then build the standalone page and dist/artifact.html yourself and take your own frames in ONE short Playwright script at 1280x720 and 390x844 (phone viewport copy, isMobile, hasTouch, DPR 3), day and night: the bar and tap wall, the hall and murals, the side glass roll-ups, the side patio, the back yard, and a walk through each of the three exits and from the back exit to the car. Judge closeness to each reference (ranked differences), the rename everywhere (no 'Lot 57' left in player-facing text), seamless exits (no fade, no black or blank frame, no camera jump), seats usable, budgets, the venue groups green. Reject on any real business's mark or trade dress, a black frame at a doorway, or a regression.
